calculate_matches: run calculate_matches to evaluate answer presence in retrieved documents using multiprocessing
has_answer: check if a document text contains any of the provided answer strings using has_answer
f1_score: compute the F1 score between a prediction and multiple ground truth answers
exact_match_score: compute the exact match score between a prediction and multiple ground truth answers
SimpleTokenizer_tokenize: tokenize text into tokens using SimpleTokenizer with optional case folding
